decision: Use catalog label status:claimed for the #4200 work-claim busy flag

governingRule.description: Land the tag in the catalog first; do not invent in the field

alternativesConsidered.option: new catalog name such as work:claimed

whyWinner: status:* is already the list-visible lifecycle facet; a new prefix would invent a facet
revisitTrigger: If status:claimed pollutes child/tracker filters, split to a coord: facet
